brief: Create a responsive product landing page for Arcwell Listening, a fictional desktop speaker made for focused listening in small rooms. Give it a distinct visual concept and a working product-interest path. The page must feel authored and complete rather than like a component gallery.

locked_facts.name: Arcwell Listening
locked_facts.description: A compact powered stereo pair for desks and small rooms.

creative_freedom: Choose composition, typography, palette, motion, and generated image or video opportunities. Do not add acoustic measurements, reviews, awards, sustainability claims, warranties, discounts, wireless features, or company history.
deterministic_acceptance: A runnable page loads without uncaught console errors.
Every product, price, shipping, and technical claim matches locked_facts or is omitted.
The finish selector is keyboard operable, visibly identifies Chalk, Oxide, and Night, and carries the selected finish into the interest state.
The product-interest call to action reveals or navigates to a form that validates email and finish and shows a local success state without a network dependency.
At 390x844 and 1440x900 the page has no horizontal document overflow and primary product content remains readable.
prefers-reduced-motion disables nonessential continuous or entrance motion.
